text:
{ "entries"  : [  { "name_han"  : "玄机直讲"  , "logic_thesis"  : "..."  , "logic_chain"  : "..."  , "logic_practice"  : "..."  , "logic_compare"  : "..."  } ] }{
  "entries": [
    {
      "name_han": "玄机直讲",
      "logic_thesis": "The text proves that the so-called “mysterious mechanism” of the golden elixir is not hidden in esoteric jargon or external substances, but is a transparent, teachable causal structure of mind–body reverse-cultivation. If the Dao could only be spoken in riddles, transmission would be impossible; therefore true alchemy must admit direct statement once the false premises (sexual dual cultivation as ultimate, furnace-and-drug literalism, destiny-fatalism) are removed. Clarity itself becomes the proof that the Path is lawful and universal, not a private miracle.",
      "logic_chain": "1. Premise: all genuine Daoist methods must be communicable without self-contradiction. 2. Inference: metaphors that cannot be cashed out into operations are either pedagogical scaffolds or deliberate concealment of error. 3. Inference: stripping metaphors reveals a single chain—stillness → recovery of pre-heaven qi → coupling of spirit and breath → reversion. 4. Inference: any practice that depends on secret sexual or mineral “medicine” fails the communicability and universality tests. 5. Conclusion: the “mystery” is only epistemic opacity in the student; the mechanism is direct, internal, and rationally exposable.",
      "logic_practice": "1. Translate every BaZi image (officer, wealth, seal, resource) into a functional role in the mind–qi economy rather than fate-labels. 2. Reject chart readings that treat luck as fixed substance; treat stems/branches as timing for reverse-cultivation of depleted elements. 3. Use “direct speech” sessions: restate any classic metaphor in operational steps before applying it to a nativity. 4. Prioritize stillness and intent-guarding as the first “firing” when chart shows scattered Fire/Metal. 5. Audit teachers/methods: if they cannot restate the mechanism without secrecy, mark the method as non-transmissible and likely false.",
      "logic_compare": "Unlike 悟真篇, which proves by coded verse and demands decoding, 玄机直讲 proves by demystification: the argument is that secrecy is often the problem, not the solution. It differs from 敲爻歌直解 by focusing less on fire-phase calendrics and more on the meta-claim that Daoist truth admits plain exposition. Its unique force is pedagogical-epistemic: it attacks obscurantism as a logical barrier to cultivation."
    },
    {
      "name_han": "无根树",
      "logic_thesis": "The text proves that authentic life has no root in the post-heaven tree of forms, desires, and social identity; therefore cultivation must “graft” spirit onto the pre-heaven root of emptiness rather than fertilize the already rootless trunk of ego. The image of a rootless tree demonstrates that ordinary existence is sustained only by borrowed post-natal qi and will collapse unless reconnected to the unborn source. Immortality is not growth of the tree but transplanting its living essence back into the void-root.",
      "logic_chain": "1. Premise: whatever depends on external conditions for its standing has no intrinsic root. 2. Inference: body, fame, emotion, and even clever practice that chase form are rootless. 3. Inference: pre-heaven original spirit/qi alone is self-so and unconditioned. 4. Inference: “grafting” means uniting post-heaven awareness with pre-heaven source at the living moment of true intention. 5. Conclusion: success is measured by independence from conditions (rootedness in Dao), not by accumulation of powers or longevity stunts.",
      "logic_practice": "1. In BaZi, treat Day Master as the “trunk” and locate which roots (support of season, resources, seal) are post-heaven crutches versus true pre-heaven capacity. 2. When chart shows “floating wood” or unsupported self, train return-to-root: breath to lower field, not more striving. 3. Use the poem’s graft metaphor: join exhausted output (hurting officer/wealth drain) back to resource/seal through rest and non-contention. 4. Daily check: if mood depends on external praise/gain, mark it as rootless branch-growth and cut it by stillness. 5. Prefer reverse schedules (early rest, noon quiet) over “adding fertilizer” (stimulants, forced yang practices).",
      "logic_compare": "Compared with 性命圭旨’s systematic diagrams, 无根树 argues poetically through a single master-metaphor—rootlessness—rather than a curriculum of stages. It differs from 赤水吟 by being more soteriological (why ordinary life fails) than technical. Its distinct logical contribution is the proof that form-based success is structurally rootless, so reverse-rooting is necessary, not optional."
    },
    {
      "name_han": "七破论",
      "logic_thesis": "The treatise proves the true Path by exhaustive negation: seven major classes of pseudo-Dao (side doors) are shown to fail internal consistency, produce opposite effects, or confuse means with ends. If a practice cannot survive critical refutation without appealing to secrecy or authority, it cannot be the universal Dao. Thus orthodoxy is defined not by lineage prestige alone but by surviving logical and empirical “breaking.”",
      "logic_chain": "1. Premise: the Dao is one; contradictory methods cannot all be ultimate. 2. Inference: popular techniques that force qi, chase visions, sexual dualism, or ritual magic claim results they cannot stabilize. 3. Inference: each fails a test—either leaks jing/qi, inflames mind, depends on partners/objects, or mistakes symptom for medicine. 4. Inference: clearing false paths narrows the field to dual cultivation of nature (xing) and life (ming) by reverse alchemy. 5. Conclusion: “breaking” is constructive: orthodoxy is the remainder after error is eliminated.",
      "logic_practice": "1. Build a personal “seven breaks” checklist for any BaZi/alchemy advice: does it force, leak, externalize, mystify, agitate, commercialize, or freeze fate? 2. When a chart reading predicts doom without remedy, break fatalism—reframe as imbalance to reverse. 3. Reject sexual-alchemy or drug shortcuts even if chart shows “peach blossom” or “strong desire stars.” 4. Use refutation in study: for each classic claim, state what would falsify it. 5. Prefer methods that quiet leakage (speech, lust, anger, overwork) over methods that add exotic techniques.",
      "logic_compare": "Unlike 玄机直讲, which affirms by plain teaching, 七破论 affirms by demolition of rivals—its logic is via negativa. It is harsher and more polemical than 悟道录’s gradual personal narrative. Its uniqueness lies in treating orthodoxy as what remains after systematic logical destruction of side-doors."
    },
    {
      "name_han": "金丹大旨图",
      "logic_thesis": "The work proves that the golden elixir is isomorphic with the cosmological process of Taiji dividing into yin–yang and recombining: if the body is a microcosm, then the macrocosmic sequence is already a complete operational map. Diagrams are not ornaments but compressed proofs—structure shows necessity. Therefore cultivation is lawful reenactment of cosmogenesis in reverse (from two back to one, from one back to void).",
      "logic_chain": "1. Premise: Dao generates One; One generates Two; Two generate the myriad. 2. Inference: post-heaven life is the “myriad” already dispersed. 3. Inference: elixir practice must reverse the arrows: gather the two, return to one, rest in void. 4. Inference: body loci (鼎炉), timing, and fire correspond to diagram positions, not arbitrary invention. 5. Conclusion: whoever grasps the diagram’s necessity grasps the whole of the great purpose without needing endless oral secrets.",
      "logic_practice": "1. Map a nativity onto Taiji logic: Day Master as present center; yin–yang stems as two; seasonal qi as the “opened” cosmos to reverse. 2. Use diagram order as practice order: first distinguish yin/yang in breath and emotion, then couple, then return. 3. When BaZi shows extreme imbalance, design “recombination” months (supportive luck) as gathering phases, not as mere good/bad luck. 4. Draw a personal elixir map: seal/resource as pre-heaven mother, officer as fire governor, wealth as post-heaven object—track leaks. 5. Teach with images before jargon so the isomorphism body–cosmos stays explicit.",
      "logic_compare": "Unlike purely verbal 道德经注, this text argues by spatial necessity of figures—logic is geometric. It differs from 周易阐真 by focusing on elixir diagrams rather than hexagram transformation as the primary proof medium. Its edge is visual-structural: the diagram is the argument."
    },
    {
      "name_han": "老子道德经玄览",
      "logic_thesis": "The text proves that the Daodejing is not merely political quietism or ethics, but a “mysterious viewing” (玄览) of the same reverse process that alchemists call returning to the root. By reading each chapter as inner optics—how the mind mirrors the Dao without dust—it shows that non-action (无为) is the highest technique, not the absence of technique. The proof is hermeneutic: coherent internal reading across chapters yields a single cultivation physics.",
      "logic_chain": "1. Premise: Laozi’s paradoxes are consistent only if they describe mind–Dao resonance, not mere statecraft. 2. Inference: “empty the mind, fill the belly” maps to xing calm and ming nourishment. 3. Inference: softness overcoming hardness is reverse of post-heaven force. 4. Inference: the sage’s non-contention is the firing that does not overburn. 5. Conclusion: 玄览 is the method—clean the mirror of awareness until Dao appears as one’s own function.",
      "logic_practice": "1. For charts dominated by harsh Officer/Kill, apply “soft overcomes hard”: yield timing, reduce confrontation months, cultivate Water/Metal receptivity. 2. Practice 玄览 daily: sit until thoughts settle; note that “seeing mystery” is reduced dust, not added visions. 3. Translate BaZi “use god” into Laozi terms: the useful is often the soft, empty, or low position in the chart. 4. When strong Rob Wealth or peer competition appears, train non-contention as strategic conservation of qi. 5. Read one Daodejing chapter as operational instruction before any predictive statement.",
      "logic_compare": "It differs from 老子翼’s anthology approach by offering a unified “mysterious viewing” lens rather than multiple schools’ notes. Against 道德宝章’s more explicit neidan decoding by Bai Yuchan, 玄览 stresses contemplative optics (mirror-mind) over staged drug language. Its distinct proof is that clean perception itself is the alchemical apparatus."
    },
    {
      "name_han": "周易阐真",
      "logic_thesis": "Liu Yiming proves that the Zhouyi is the complete metaphysical grammar of reverse alchemy: hexagrams encode the rise and fall of yin–yang fire, not fortune-telling alone. If the Changes describe how the cosmos opens and closes, then “elucidating the true” means reading every line as a law of mind–qi transformation. Prediction is secondary; the primary truth is that destiny can be reversed because the same laws that disperse can recombine.",
      "logic_chain": "1. Premise: Yijing images are process laws of yin–yang, not arbitrary omens. 2. Inference: human birth charts and luck cycles are special cases of those laws. 3. Inference: forward movement (顺) produces ordinary life and death; reverse movement (逆) produces elixir. 4. Inference: each hexagram pair (e.g., after completion/before completion) maps a cultivation checkpoint. 5. Conclusion: true Yijing study is identical with true neidan theory—one science of change.",
      "logic_practice": "1. Treat BaZi luck pillars as hexagram-like phase changes: identify when yang peaks and must be contained (止火). 2. Use reverse reading: a “bad” clash may be the exact moment for breaking post-heaven habits. 3. Map Day Master and season to Qian–Kun / Kan–Li frames before elemental list-making. 4. Time meditation and rest to Chart “closure” phases (storage branches) rather than only to auspicious days. 5. When clients ask only prediction, reframe one concrete reverse action that obeys the same change-law.",
      "logic_compare": "Unlike popular Yijing divination manuals, 周易阐真 subordinates omen to alchemy—its proof goal is reversion, not forecasting accuracy. Compared with 金丹大旨图, it uses hexagram transformation rather than Taiji diagrams as the main logical engine. Its uniqueness is fusing Confucian classic status of the Yi with Quanzhen reverse-cultivation doctrine into one system."
    },
    {
      "name_han": "西游原旨",
      "logic_thesis": "The text proves that Journey to the West is a complete allegory of dual cultivation: the pilgrims, demons, and scriptures are personae of mind, essence, and qi in conflict and reunion. If every episode reduces without remainder to neidan operations, then the novel’s “original aim” is not adventure morality but a public map of private work. Narrative consistency across one hundred chapters becomes evidence for a single internal physics of enlightenment.",
      "logic_chain": "1. Premise: serious allegory is systematic, not occasional symbolism. 2. Inference: Monkey = mind/spirit, Pig = desire/jing, Friar Sand = stabilized qi, Horse = will, Tang Monk = pure nature needing protection. 3. Inference: demons are projections of unrefined aggregates; defeating them is refining, not violence. 4. Inference: scripture-fetching is return with true yin–yang unity (the true “West”). 5. Conclusion: popular culture can encode elite Dao—reading correctly converts entertainment into curriculum.",
      "logic_practice": "1. Assign client chart factors to pilgrim roles: flying Monkey mind (strong Food/Hurt), Pig appetite (Wealth/Desire), etc., then prescribe which “disciple” to restrain first. 2. Treat annual “demon” events (clashes, punishments) as named inner obstacles, not only outer disasters. 3. Practice: when anger arises, call it “Monkey” and return it to the Master (still nature) before acting. 4. Use story order as stage order: vow → team assembly (gather three treasures) → successive refinements → return. 5. Avoid literalist magic readings that chase siddhis; measure progress by fewer inner demons, not more powers.",
      "logic_compare": "Unlike 敲爻歌直解’s technical fire phases, 西游原旨 proves via narrative isomorphism—logic of story equals logic of mind. It differs from 悟道录 by using a public novel rather than personal memoir as the vehicle. Its distinctive claim is that mass literature can be the most complete “open secret” of the elixir path."
    },
    {
      "name_han": "悟道录",
      "logic_thesis": "The record proves that awakening is an incremental, testable sequence of recognitions rather than a single mystical rupture: each error corrected becomes a premise for the next insight. By narrating wrong turns and corrections, it shows that Dao-learning obeys experiential logic—verification in the person—not mere doctrinal assent. The Path is real because it can be walked, failed, and re-walked with cumulative clarity.",
      "logic_chain": "1. Premise: if the Dao is real, practice must generate discriminable stages of evidence. 2. Inference: beginners confuse stillness with blankness, movement with leakage, and texts with attainment. 3. Inference: recording errors converts them into premises for better method. 4. Inference: gradual dual work on xing and ming eventually coheres into stable non-dual function. 5. Conclusion: “record of awakening” is itself a proof-form: lived dialectic of mistake and correction.",
      "logic_practice": "1. Keep a cultivation/BaZi journal: hypothesis (chart claim) → practice → result → revision. 2. Sequence client work: first stop leaks, then build stillness, then timing, never reverse. 3. Treat “failed luck remedies” as data, not shame—adjust the causal model. 4. For strong Learning/Seal charts, warn against book-hoarding without verification. 5. Define stage gates (sleep quality, emotional recovery, less compulsive speech) as empirical signs of progress.",
      "logic_compare": "Unlike 七破论’s external polemic, 悟道录 breaks errors from inside autobiography. It is less cosmological than 周易阐真 and more pedagogical-experiential. Its unique logic is dialectical self-correction as the form of proof."
    },
    {
      "name_han": "敲爻歌直解",
      "logic_thesis": "The direct explanation proves that Lü Dongbin’s “knocking the lines” song is a rigorous calendar of fire phases: each “knock” is a timed decision to advance, hold, or withdraw heat according to hexagram logic. Timing is not superstition; it is the conclusion that unseasonal force ruins the medicine. Mastery of when equals mastery of how.",
      "logic_chain": "1. Premise: pre-heaven medicine arises only at specific openings of qi. 2. Inference: constant hard practice without timing either dissipates or overburns. 3. Inference: hexagram lines mark thresholds of yin–yang proportion in the body-time continuum. 4. Inference: “knocking” is testing the line—know the moment, then act with exact dose. 5. Conclusion: direct decoding of the song yields an operational chronometry of elixir work.",
      "logic_practice": "1. Align BaZi hour/day pillars with practice windows: zi–wu axis for major firings; avoid forced work in dead seasonal qi. 2. When luck pillar shifts element, change “fire dose” (intensity of meditation/work), not only life plans. 3. Teach stop-fire: when signs of dryness/irritability appear, hold—overburning is a timing error. 4. Use “knock” as diagnostic question before action: is this moment gathering, refining, or resting? 5. For charts with violent clashes, schedule recovery days as mandatory 止火.",
      "logic_compare": "Compared with 玄机直讲’s general demystification, this text specializes in temporal logic of firing. It is more technical than 赤水吟’s poetic expression and less narrative than 西游原旨. Its distinct proof is that chronometry is the core of method, not an accessory."
    },
    {
      "name_han": "道书一贯真机易简录",
      "logic_thesis": "The work proves that the ocean of Daoist books conceals one continuous mechanism, and that this mechanism is “easy and simple” once reordered into a single causal curriculum (companions/place → vessel/fire → stillness → foundation → picking the medicine → incubation). Multiplicity of texts is an archival accident; unity of true mechanism is the rational residue after classification. Ease is the sign of truth: what requires endless complications is still confused.",
      "logic_chain": "1. Premise: contradictory surface instructions either address different stages or include errors. 2. Inference: sorting by stage removes most contradictions. 3. Inference: prerequisites (法财侣地, ethics, quiet) are causal, not moral decoration. 4. Inference: without foundation, “picking medicine” is theft from an empty vault. 5. Conclusion: one threaded sequence makes the Path simple, teachable, and self-auditing.",
      "logic_practice": "1. Build a BaZi consultation pipeline matching the volumes: conditions of life → emotional furnace → quiet → foundation → timing → nurture. 2. Refuse advanced “medicine timing” advice for clients still leaking via sex, speech, or overwork. 3. Use “easy-simple” test: if a remedy needs ten talismans, simplify to one causal habit change. 4. Catalog classic quotes under stages so study never floats free of sequence. 5. Measure progress by stage completion, not by collecting methods.",
      "logic_compare": "Unlike single-topic polemics (七破论) or single-metaphor poems (无根树), this text’s logic is architectonic: unity through ordered synthesis. It differs from 性命要旨 by emphasizing bibliographic consolidation of many books into one easy thread. Its signature claim is that simplicity is an epistemological criterion of the true mechanism."
    },
    {
      "name_han": "赤水吟",
      "logic_thesis": "The chants prove—through condensed poetic inference—that nature and life must be cultivated together, and that the “red water” image marks the living, dangerous, fertile boundary where post-heaven blood/qi can be reversed into spiritual fluid. Beauty of verse is not ornament: it compresses causal relations so they can be memorized as operative seals. What cannot be sung into the marrow has not yet been understood.",
      "logic_chain": "1. Premise: dual cultivation is required because xing without ming is empty; ming without xing is blind longevity. 2. Inference: poetic images fix the coupling points (water–fire, metal–wood) in affective memory. 3. Inference: “red water” signals the living intermediate—neither pure form nor pure void. 4. Inference: chanting regulates breath and intent simultaneously, embodying the thesis. 5. Conclusion: poetry is a valid proof vehicle when it encodes necessary relations of reverse alchemy.",
      "logic_practice": "1. For Dry or Water-deficient charts, use short chant+breath sets rather than only conceptual study. 2. Pair each poem image with a BaZi pair (e.g., water–fire) and a daily micro-practice. 3. When emotion runs “red” (passion/anger), treat it as unrefined intermediate—cool with stillness, don’t suppress into dead water. 4. Memorize 2–3 verses as portable correctives during luck shocks. 5. Integrate aesthetic joy as a sign of xing engagement so practice does not become grim force.",
      "logic_compare": "Unlike 金丹大旨图’s diagrams, 赤水吟 proves through lyrical compression and embodied recitation. It is less polemical than 七破论 and less narrative than 西游原旨. Its distinctness is aesthetic-operative: beauty as mnemonic of necessity in dual cultivation."
    },
    {
      "name_han": "性命要旨",
      "logic_thesis": "Wang Dongting’s text proves that all advanced talk collapses into two coupled essentials—xing (nature/spirit) and ming (life/qi-form)—and that Western-school method is judged by whether it reintegrates them without bias. If either pole is absolutized, the system fails: quietism or energetic athleticism both abort the elixir. The “essentials” are therefore a minimal sufficient ontology for practice.",
      "logic_chain": "1. Premise: human being is bipartite in function—awareness and vitality—yet one in origin. 2. Inference: post-heaven education splits them (mind vs body, ethics vs longevity). 3. Inference: reintegration requires ordered work on both, often ming first when foundation is weak, without abandoning xing. 4. Inference: Taiji and yin–yang language is only the physics of that reintegration. 5. Conclusion: mastery is measured by unity of spirit and qi in ordinary action, not by special states alone.",
      "logic_practice": "1. Diagnose every chart as xing-biased (strong Seal/Eating, weak body) or ming-biased (strong body/Wealth, restless spirit) and assign rebalancing. 2. Sequence: stop ming leaks → stabilize breath/sleep → open xing clarity → couple. 3. In Western-school flavor, emphasize practical breath-qi work while holding non-attachment. 4. Reject pure meditation plans for exhausted ming charts; reject pure qigong for scattered xing charts. 5. Define “aim” as functional unity under stress (conflict months), not peak experiences.",
      "logic_compare": "Compared with 道书一贯真机易简录’s multi-volume synthesis, 性命要旨 is a minimalist essentialism: two poles, one aim. It is more systematically bipartite than 无根树’s single root metaphor. Its distinct logic is sufficiency—few principles, exhaustive implications for method choice."
    },
    {
      "name_han": "孙不二女功内丹次第诗注",
      "logic_thesis": "The annotated sequence proves that female internal alchemy is not a diluted copy of male method but a distinct causal order grounded in female physiology and lunar timing, while sharing the same ultimate reversion to void. If bodily starting conditions differ, intermediate steps must differ; otherwise the method contradicts its own premise of working with real qi. Gendered sequence is thus a requirement of consistency, not a social concession.",
      "logic_chain": "1. Premise: practice must begin from the actual body-mind one has. 2. Inference: female jing-blood dynamics and cyclical timing change the meaning of “foundation” and “cutting the red dragon.” 3. Inference: poetic stages provide ordered checkpoints specific to that process. 4. Inference: annotations convert poetry into verifiable signs of stage completion. 5. Conclusion: true universality of Dao includes particularized methods; one-size male templates are illogical for female practice.",
      "logic_practice": "1. For female nativities, weight lunar/period-related cycles and blood-qi depletion before applying male-centric firing schedules. 2. Prioritize replenishment and cooling of deficient Fire/Blood patterns before aggressive yang practices. 3. Use stage poems as consentful curriculum: do not skip “beheading the red dragon” metaphors into forced suppression. 4. In BaZi, read Resource/Seal and Officer carefully as support for safe foundation, not only as status stars. 5. Validate each stage by embodied signs (stability, less depletion) rather than copying male lore.",
      "logic_compare": "Unlike generic neidan manuals that universalize male sequences, this text’s logic insists on physiological differentiation. It differs from 五篇灵文’s unisex five-phase elixir outline by specializing the path. Its unique proof is that orthodoxy requires adaptive sequence, not identical drills."
    },
    {
      "name_han": "老子翼",
      "logic_thesis": "Jiao Hong’s “wings” prove that the Daodejing’s meaning is polyphonic yet bounded: by assembling major commentaries as auxiliary “wings,” it shows that no single scholastic line exhausts Laozi, while mutual correction among wings prevents arbitrary reading. The logical form is critical anthology—truth emerges from structured plurality under the primary text. Authority is distributed across conversation, not monopolized by one sectarian decoder.",
      "logic_chain": "1. Premise: a terse classic generates legitimate interpretive diversity. 2. Inference: isolating one commentary creates blind spots and forced systemizations. 3. Inference: juxtaposing wings exposes where readings converge (strong claims) and diverge (hypothesis). 4. Inference: convergence around emptiness, softness, and reverse-to-root marks the stable core. 5. Conclusion: scholarly multi-perspective method is itself Dao-consistent: not forcing one rigid name.",
      "logic_practice": "1. When interpreting a BaZi classic rule, open at least two “wings” (schools) before deciding. 2. Mark consensus techniques (reduce leakage, follow season) as high confidence; mark sect-only claims as experimental. 3. Use anthology logic in teaching: present alternatives and the test that would decide. 4. Avoid guru-monopoly: allow texts to correct teachers. 5. For ambiguous chart patterns, hold dual hypotheses until life evidence converges.",
      "logic_compare": "Unlike 道德宝章 or 老子道德经玄览, which push a unified neidan reading, 老子翼’s logic is meta-hermeneutic and pluralist. It differs from 道德经注’s single-voice system by design. Its distinction is that the method of gathering wings is the argument against interpretive tyranny."
    },
    {
      "name_han": "道德经注",
      "logic_thesis": "A classical line-by-line commentary proves that Laozi’s paradoxes form a coherent ontology of the nameless source and a political-ethical physics of non-forcing. By making each chapter entail the next without alchemy-specific jargon, it shows that order arises when rulers and persons stop imposing artificial names and desires on the root. The proof is systematic consistency: non-action is the most efficient causality.",
      "logic_chain": "1. Premise: the Dao as non-being/being source precedes all useful forms. 2. Inference: desire-based naming multiplies disorder in state and person. 3. Inference: returning to simplicity restores spontaneous order (自然). 4. Inference: soft, low, empty positions have strategic causal power. 5. Conclusion: annotation demonstrates a complete practical philosophy of alignment with source—usable even before esoteric neidan overlays.",
      "logic_practice": "1. In BaZi counseling, prefer “reduce forcing” remedies over complex symbolic fixes when Officer/Kill is heavy. 2. Translate “nameless simplicity” into lifestyle: fewer roles, clearer sleep/food baselines. 3. Use soft positions in the chart (hidden stems, dormant qi) as strategic reserves, not weaknesses alone. 4. Apply non-action in timing: sometimes the correct move in a clash year is non-escalation. 5. Read commentary as training in causal minimalism—one root change beats ten branches.",
      "logic_compare": "Compared with 道德宝章’s alchemical decoding, 道德经注 (in the mainstream classical sense) argues a more general ontological-ethical physics. It is less anthological than 老子翼 and less explicitly elixir-staged than 道德经解 in Daoist-sect usages. Its distinct logic is philosophical coherence without requiring neidan premises."
    },
    {
      "name_han": "道德宝章",
      "logic_thesis": "Bai Yuchan’s “precious chapters” prove that the Daodejing is a sealed neidan scripture: chapters map onto spirit–qi work so tightly that Laozi becomes an upper vehicle of golden elixir rather than mere quietist politics. The argument is translational consistency—once key terms (One, spirit of the valley, mysterious female) are fixed as internal functions, the book reads as a continuous operations manual. Preciousness lies in this reversible mapping between classic and practice.",
      "logic_chain": "1. Premise: Southern-lineage neidan holds that ancient classics encrypt elixir. 2. Inference: stable internal referents can be assigned to Laozi’s images. 3. Inference: political metaphors then re-describe governance of the inner kingdom. 4. Inference: non-action equals non-forcing of post-heaven intention upon pre-heaven medicine. 5. Conclusion: Daodejing, properly decoded, is a complete precious manual of return.",
      "logic_practice": "1. Re-read “valley spirit” as open, receptive mid-space practice; use for charts with rigid Metal/Officer over-control. 2. Treat “mysterious female” as inexhaustible resource function—cultivate Seal/Resource lifestyle in depleted nativities. 3. Govern the “state” of the body: reduce tax (overwork), stop war (anger), fill granaries (sleep/jing). 4. Apply chapter-order as deepening: from ontology to embodiment to social non-contention. 5. Test decoding: if a reading cannot become a bodily task, revise the reading.",
      "logic_compare": "Unlike 道德经注’s philosophical generalism, 道德宝章 commits to full neidan encryption. Relative to 老子道德经玄览’s mirror-contemplation emphasis, Bai’s text is more operational-elixir in Southern Song style. Its uniqueness is confident one-to-one mapping of Laozi onto golden elixir craft."
    },
    {
      "name_han": "道德经解",
      "logic_thesis": "The “explanation” genre proves that Laozi becomes usable only when compressed paradox is expanded into explicit causal sentences and examples—understanding is the middle term between text and practice. If students cannot restate the classic in clear propositions, they cannot apply it; therefore 解 is not dilution but necessary logical unpacking. Clarity here serves conversion of wisdom into conduct.",
      "logic_chain": "1. Premise: ultra-brief classics underdetermine action. 2. Inference: authentic explanation adds structure without adding alien dogma. 3. Inference: each chapter yields premises about mind, society, and reverse effort. 4. Inference: practical maxims must remain falsifiable in daily governance of desire. 5. Conclusion: 解 completes the communicative arc from mystery to method while remaining subordinate to the root text.",
      "logic_practice": "1. After any Daodejing quote in a BaZi session, force a one-sentence operational gloss. 2. Build a personal glossary: Dao, de, soft, reverse—each with a chart-related behavior. 3. Use explanations to design week-long experiments (e.g., “lower position” in conflict). 4. Avoid explanation bloat: cut any gloss that cannot change a choice. 5. Teach clients to re-explain in their own words as a mastery check.",
      "logic_compare": "Compared with 老子翼’s multi-commentator wings, 道德经解 typically offers a single continuous expository voice. It is more pedagogical-unpacking than 道德宝章’s esoteric remapping. Its distinct logic is communicative: expansion as the condition of practice."
    },
    {
      "name_han": "青天歌注释",
      "logic_thesis": "Annotation of the “Song of the Blue Sky” proves that pure yang mind—clear as an open sky—is both the method and the verification of alchemy: clouds are adventitious thoughts/desires, not the sky’s nature. If clarity can be sung, recognized, and stabilized, then enlightenment is not remote metaphysics but the sky-like quality of awareness restored. Commentary ties poetic rapture to disciplined clearing.",
      "logic_chain": "1. Premise: original mind is naturally clear (qing tian). 2. Inference: afflictions are weather, not essence. 3. Inference: practice is dispersing clouds without attacking the sky. 4. Inference: stable blue-sky mind naturally orders qi (ming follows xing clarity). 5. Conclusion: the song plus notes provide a criterion of attainment—sky-likeness under conditions—not accumulation of inner scenery.",
      "logic_practice": "1. For cluttered charts (many clash/punishment/desire stars), train “sky watching”: note thoughts as clouds; return. 2. Use sky criterion in review: did today’s practice leave more open awareness or more images/drama? 3. Pair with breath to clear “steam” when Fire steam-clouds the mind. 4. In prediction years of turmoil, prescribe sky practice as first response before strategic action. 5. Avoid chasing visionary “auspicious clouds” as goals; they are still weather.",
      "logic_compare": "Unlike 敲爻歌直解’s fire-timing grids, 青天歌注释 centers xing-clarity as the master proof. It is lighter and more mind-only in emphasis than 性命要旨’s strict dual essentials, though annotations often reconnect to qi. Its uniqueness is the sky metaphor as a live phenomenological standard of the Path."
    },
    {
      "name_han": "五篇灵文",
      "logic_thesis": "The Five Spiritual Texts prove that elixir work is a closed causal sequence of five necessities—jade liquid, producing the medicine, gathering, obtaining, and warming/nurturing—each preconditioning the next. Skipping stages is not ambitious; it is logically invalid, like harvesting without planting. Attributed Northern-lineage notes bind the sequence to heavenly heart as master and original spirit as function, proving method as ordered transformation of the three treasures.",
      "logic_chain": "1. Premise: internal medicines appear only after preparatory fluids/qi are restored (玉液). 2. Inference: production (产药) without gathering skill wastes the peak. 3. Inference: gathering without the ability to “obtain” (stabilize) is temporary excitement. 4. Inference: obtaining without warming leads to regression. 5. Conclusion: five chapters are five non-negotiable links; the Path is the integrity of the chain under guidance of heavenly heart.",
      "logic_practice": "1. Audit practice/BaZi plans against the five links; locate the broken link (usually foundation or stop-fire nurture). 2. For weak Resource charts, emphasize jade-liquid restoration (sleep, fluids, gentle breath) before “gathering” intense methods. 3. Time “gathering” to real openings (seasonal/day-night), not willfulness. 4. After any breakthrough (insight, energy peak), schedule温养 days. 5. Hold 天心 as master: if ego-excitement leads, abort the stage as false medicine.",
      "logic_compare": "Unlike 孙不二…次第’s gender-specific poetry, 五篇灵文 offers a compact unisex five-phase causal skeleton of Northern neidan. It is more strictly sequential than 玄机直讲’s general plain teaching. Its distinct proof is chain-necessity: five named links as the minimal complete engine of elixir."
    },
    {
      "name_han": "仙道还元真经",
      "logic_thesis": "The scripture proves that the immortal path is identical with “returning to the origin” (还元): all techniques are true only insofar as they reverse dispersion back to the pre-heaven source. Immortality is not endless forward survival of the post-heaven person but completion of reversion; thus “true” marks correspondence with origin, not miraculous deviation from law. The end-state is the beginning recovered consciously.",
      "logic_chain": "1. Premise: living beings fall from origin into multiplicity and leakage. 2. Inference: forward cultivation that only enhances post-heaven skills deepens exile. 3. Inference: true immortal method must be reverse-oriented at every step. 4. Inference: signs of authenticity are increasing simplicity, unity, and independence from conditions. 5. Conclusion: 还元 is the definition, criterion, and method of 仙道—one term, complete law.",
      "logic_practice": "1. Evaluate every BaZi remedy by the return test: does it reduce dispersion and restore origin-like simplicity? 2. Prefer reverse interventions (rest, silence, containment) when charts show hyper-output. 3. Track annual luck as approach/departure from personal origin pattern (day-master balance), not only as wealth events. 4. End sessions with one 还元 act (breath to root, gratitude without grasping). 5. Discard techniques that produce more complexity, dependency, or identity inflation.",
      "logic_compare": "Compared with 无根树’s graft metaphor, 仙道还元真经 states the same reversion in scriptural definitional form—origin as the truth-condition of all methods. It is more slogan-complete and criterion-focused than 悟道录’s long experiential dialectic. Its unique logical role is final-criterion: whatever does not return to origin is not the immortal path, regardless of brand."
    }
  ]

entries.logic_thesis: The text proves that the so-called “mysterious mechanism” of the golden elixir is not hidden in esoteric jargon or external substances, but is a transparent, teachable causal structure of mind–body reverse-cultivation. If the Dao could only be spoken in riddles, transmission would be impossible; therefore true alchemy must admit direct statement once the false premises (sexual dual cultivation as ultimate, furnace-and-drug literalism, destiny-fatalism) are removed. Clarity itself becomes the proof that the Path is lawful and universal, not a private miracle.
entries.logic_chain: 1. Premise: all genuine Daoist methods must be communicable without self-contradiction. 2. Inference: metaphors that cannot be cashed out into operations are either pedagogical scaffolds or deliberate concealment of error. 3. Inference: stripping metaphors reveals a single chain—stillness → recovery of pre-heaven qi → coupling of spirit and breath → reversion. 4. Inference: any practice that depends on secret sexual or mineral “medicine” fails the communicability and universality tests. 5. Conclusion: the “mystery” is only epistemic opacity in the student; the mechanism is direct, internal, and rationally exposable.
entries.logic_practice: 1. Translate every BaZi image (officer, wealth, seal, resource) into a functional role in the mind–qi economy rather than fate-labels. 2. Reject chart readings that treat luck as fixed substance; treat stems/branches as timing for reverse-cultivation of depleted elements. 3. Use “direct speech” sessions: restate any classic metaphor in operational steps before applying it to a nativity. 4. Prioritize stillness and intent-guarding as the first “firing” when chart shows scattered Fire/Metal. 5. Audit teachers/methods: if they cannot restate the mechanism without secrecy, mark the method as non-transmissible and likely false.
entries.logic_compare: Unlike 悟真篇, which proves by coded verse and demands decoding, 玄机直讲 proves by demystification: the argument is that secrecy is often the problem, not the solution. It differs from 敲爻歌直解 by focusing less on fire-phase calendrics and more on the meta-claim that Daoist truth admits plain exposition. Its unique force is pedagogical-epistemic: it attacks obscurantism as a logical barrier to cultivation.

entries.logic_thesis: The text proves that authentic life has no root in the post-heaven tree of forms, desires, and social identity; therefore cultivation must “graft” spirit onto the pre-heaven root of emptiness rather than fertilize the already rootless trunk of ego. The image of a rootless tree demonstrates that ordinary existence is sustained only by borrowed post-natal qi and will collapse unless reconnected to the unborn source. Immortality is not growth of the tree but transplanting its living essence back into the void-root.
entries.logic_chain: 1. Premise: whatever depends on external conditions for its standing has no intrinsic root. 2. Inference: body, fame, emotion, and even clever practice that chase form are rootless. 3. Inference: pre-heaven original spirit/qi alone is self-so and unconditioned. 4. Inference: “grafting” means uniting post-heaven awareness with pre-heaven source at the living moment of true intention. 5. Conclusion: success is measured by independence from conditions (rootedness in Dao), not by accumulation of powers or longevity stunts.
entries.logic_practice: 1. In BaZi, treat Day Master as the “trunk” and locate which roots (support of season, resources, seal) are post-heaven crutches versus true pre-heaven capacity. 2. When chart shows “floating wood” or unsupported self, train return-to-root: breath to lower field, not more striving. 3. Use the poem’s graft metaphor: join exhausted output (hurting officer/wealth drain) back to resource/seal through rest and non-contention. 4. Daily check: if mood depends on external praise/gain, mark it as rootless branch-growth and cut it by stillness. 5. Prefer reverse schedules (early rest, noon quiet) over “adding fertilizer” (stimulants, forced yang practices).
entries.logic_compare: Compared with 性命圭旨’s systematic diagrams, 无根树 argues poetically through a single master-metaphor—rootlessness—rather than a curriculum of stages. It differs from 赤水吟 by being more soteriological (why ordinary life fails) than technical. Its distinct logical contribution is the proof that form-based success is structurally rootless, so reverse-rooting is necessary, not optional.

entries.logic_thesis: The treatise proves the true Path by exhaustive negation: seven major classes of pseudo-Dao (side doors) are shown to fail internal consistency, produce opposite effects, or confuse means with ends. If a practice cannot survive critical refutation without appealing to secrecy or authority, it cannot be the universal Dao. Thus orthodoxy is defined not by lineage prestige alone but by surviving logical and empirical “breaking.”
entries.logic_chain: 1. Premise: the Dao is one; contradictory methods cannot all be ultimate. 2. Inference: popular techniques that force qi, chase visions, sexual dualism, or ritual magic claim results they cannot stabilize. 3. Inference: each fails a test—either leaks jing/qi, inflames mind, depends on partners/objects, or mistakes symptom for medicine. 4. Inference: clearing false paths narrows the field to dual cultivation of nature (xing) and life (ming) by reverse alchemy. 5. Conclusion: “breaking” is constructive: orthodoxy is the remainder after error is eliminated.
entries.logic_practice: 1. Build a personal “seven breaks” checklist for any BaZi/alchemy advice: does it force, leak, externalize, mystify, agitate, commercialize, or freeze fate? 2. When a chart reading predicts doom without remedy, break fatalism—reframe as imbalance to reverse. 3. Reject sexual-alchemy or drug shortcuts even if chart shows “peach blossom” or “strong desire stars.” 4. Use refutation in study: for each classic claim, state what would falsify it. 5. Prefer methods that quiet leakage (speech, lust, anger, overwork) over methods that add exotic techniques.
entries.logic_compare: Unlike 玄机直讲, which affirms by plain teaching, 七破论 affirms by demolition of rivals—its logic is via negativa. It is harsher and more polemical than 悟道录’s gradual personal narrative. Its uniqueness lies in treating orthodoxy as what remains after systematic logical destruction of side-doors.

entries.logic_thesis: The work proves that the golden elixir is isomorphic with the cosmological process of Taiji dividing into yin–yang and recombining: if the body is a microcosm, then the macrocosmic sequence is already a complete operational map. Diagrams are not ornaments but compressed proofs—structure shows necessity. Therefore cultivation is lawful reenactment of cosmogenesis in reverse (from two back to one, from one back to void).
entries.logic_chain: 1. Premise: Dao generates One; One generates Two; Two generate the myriad. 2. Inference: post-heaven life is the “myriad” already dispersed. 3. Inference: elixir practice must reverse the arrows: gather the two, return to one, rest in void. 4. Inference: body loci (鼎炉), timing, and fire correspond to diagram positions, not arbitrary invention. 5. Conclusion: whoever grasps the diagram’s necessity grasps the whole of the great purpose without needing endless oral secrets.
entries.logic_practice: 1. Map a nativity onto Taiji logic: Day Master as present center; yin–yang stems as two; seasonal qi as the “opened” cosmos to reverse. 2. Use diagram order as practice order: first distinguish yin/yang in breath and emotion, then couple, then return. 3. When BaZi shows extreme imbalance, design “recombination” months (supportive luck) as gathering phases, not as mere good/bad luck. 4. Draw a personal elixir map: seal/resource as pre-heaven mother, officer as fire governor, wealth as post-heaven object—track leaks. 5. Teach with images before jargon so the isomorphism body–cosmos stays explicit.
entries.logic_compare: Unlike purely verbal 道德经注, this text argues by spatial necessity of figures—logic is geometric. It differs from 周易阐真 by focusing on elixir diagrams rather than hexagram transformation as the primary proof medium. Its edge is visual-structural: the diagram is the argument.

entries.logic_thesis: The text proves that the Daodejing is not merely political quietism or ethics, but a “mysterious viewing” (玄览) of the same reverse process that alchemists call returning to the root. By reading each chapter as inner optics—how the mind mirrors the Dao without dust—it shows that non-action (无为) is the highest technique, not the absence of technique. The proof is hermeneutic: coherent internal reading across chapters yields a single cultivation physics.
entries.logic_chain: 1. Premise: Laozi’s paradoxes are consistent only if they describe mind–Dao resonance, not mere statecraft. 2. Inference: “empty the mind, fill the belly” maps to xing calm and ming nourishment. 3. Inference: softness overcoming hardness is reverse of post-heaven force. 4. Inference: the sage’s non-contention is the firing that does not overburn. 5. Conclusion: 玄览 is the method—clean the mirror of awareness until Dao appears as one’s own function.
entries.logic_practice: 1. For charts dominated by harsh Officer/Kill, apply “soft overcomes hard”: yield timing, reduce confrontation months, cultivate Water/Metal receptivity. 2. Practice 玄览 daily: sit until thoughts settle; note that “seeing mystery” is reduced dust, not added visions. 3. Translate BaZi “use god” into Laozi terms: the useful is often the soft, empty, or low position in the chart. 4. When strong Rob Wealth or peer competition appears, train non-contention as strategic conservation of qi. 5. Read one Daodejing chapter as operational instruction before any predictive statement.
entries.logic_compare: It differs from 老子翼’s anthology approach by offering a unified “mysterious viewing” lens rather than multiple schools’ notes. Against 道德宝章’s more explicit neidan decoding by Bai Yuchan, 玄览 stresses contemplative optics (mirror-mind) over staged drug language. Its distinct proof is that clean perception itself is the alchemical apparatus.

entries.logic_thesis: Liu Yiming proves that the Zhouyi is the complete metaphysical grammar of reverse alchemy: hexagrams encode the rise and fall of yin–yang fire, not fortune-telling alone. If the Changes describe how the cosmos opens and closes, then “elucidating the true” means reading every line as a law of mind–qi transformation. Prediction is secondary; the primary truth is that destiny can be reversed because the same laws that disperse can recombine.
entries.logic_chain: 1. Premise: Yijing images are process laws of yin–yang, not arbitrary omens. 2. Inference: human birth charts and luck cycles are special cases of those laws. 3. Inference: forward movement (顺) produces ordinary life and death; reverse movement (逆) produces elixir. 4. Inference: each hexagram pair (e.g., after completion/before completion) maps a cultivation checkpoint. 5. Conclusion: true Yijing study is identical with true neidan theory—one science of change.
entries.logic_practice: 1. Treat BaZi luck pillars as hexagram-like phase changes: identify when yang peaks and must be contained (止火). 2. Use reverse reading: a “bad” clash may be the exact moment for breaking post-heaven habits. 3. Map Day Master and season to Qian–Kun / Kan–Li frames before elemental list-making. 4. Time meditation and rest to Chart “closure” phases (storage branches) rather than only to auspicious days. 5. When clients ask only prediction, reframe one concrete reverse action that obeys the same change-law.
entries.logic_compare: Unlike popular Yijing divination manuals, 周易阐真 subordinates omen to alchemy—its proof goal is reversion, not forecasting accuracy. Compared with 金丹大旨图, it uses hexagram transformation rather than Taiji diagrams as the main logical engine. Its uniqueness is fusing Confucian classic status of the Yi with Quanzhen reverse-cultivation doctrine into one system.

entries.logic_thesis: The text proves that Journey to the West is a complete allegory of dual cultivation: the pilgrims, demons, and scriptures are personae of mind, essence, and qi in conflict and reunion. If every episode reduces without remainder to neidan operations, then the novel’s “original aim” is not adventure morality but a public map of private work. Narrative consistency across one hundred chapters becomes evidence for a single internal physics of enlightenment.
entries.logic_chain: 1. Premise: serious allegory is systematic, not occasional symbolism. 2. Inference: Monkey = mind/spirit, Pig = desire/jing, Friar Sand = stabilized qi, Horse = will, Tang Monk = pure nature needing protection. 3. Inference: demons are projections of unrefined aggregates; defeating them is refining, not violence. 4. Inference: scripture-fetching is return with true yin–yang unity (the true “West”). 5. Conclusion: popular culture can encode elite Dao—reading correctly converts entertainment into curriculum.
entries.logic_practice: 1. Assign client chart factors to pilgrim roles: flying Monkey mind (strong Food/Hurt), Pig appetite (Wealth/Desire), etc., then prescribe which “disciple” to restrain first. 2. Treat annual “demon” events (clashes, punishments) as named inner obstacles, not only outer disasters. 3. Practice: when anger arises, call it “Monkey” and return it to the Master (still nature) before acting. 4. Use story order as stage order: vow → team assembly (gather three treasures) → successive refinements → return. 5. Avoid literalist magic readings that chase siddhis; measure progress by fewer inner demons, not more powers.
entries.logic_compare: Unlike 敲爻歌直解’s technical fire phases, 西游原旨 proves via narrative isomorphism—logic of story equals logic of mind. It differs from 悟道录 by using a public novel rather than personal memoir as the vehicle. Its distinctive claim is that mass literature can be the most complete “open secret” of the elixir path.

entries.logic_thesis: The record proves that awakening is an incremental, testable sequence of recognitions rather than a single mystical rupture: each error corrected becomes a premise for the next insight. By narrating wrong turns and corrections, it shows that Dao-learning obeys experiential logic—verification in the person—not mere doctrinal assent. The Path is real because it can be walked, failed, and re-walked with cumulative clarity.
entries.logic_chain: 1. Premise: if the Dao is real, practice must generate discriminable stages of evidence. 2. Inference: beginners confuse stillness with blankness, movement with leakage, and texts with attainment. 3. Inference: recording errors converts them into premises for better method. 4. Inference: gradual dual work on xing and ming eventually coheres into stable non-dual function. 5. Conclusion: “record of awakening” is itself a proof-form: lived dialectic of mistake and correction.
entries.logic_practice: 1. Keep a cultivation/BaZi journal: hypothesis (chart claim) → practice → result → revision. 2. Sequence client work: first stop leaks, then build stillness, then timing, never reverse. 3. Treat “failed luck remedies” as data, not shame—adjust the causal model. 4. For strong Learning/Seal charts, warn against book-hoarding without verification. 5. Define stage gates (sleep quality, emotional recovery, less compulsive speech) as empirical signs of progress.
entries.logic_compare: Unlike 七破论’s external polemic, 悟道录 breaks errors from inside autobiography. It is less cosmological than 周易阐真 and more pedagogical-experiential. Its unique logic is dialectical self-correction as the form of proof.

entries.logic_thesis: The direct explanation proves that Lü Dongbin’s “knocking the lines” song is a rigorous calendar of fire phases: each “knock” is a timed decision to advance, hold, or withdraw heat according to hexagram logic. Timing is not superstition; it is the conclusion that unseasonal force ruins the medicine. Mastery of when equals mastery of how.
entries.logic_chain: 1. Premise: pre-heaven medicine arises only at specific openings of qi. 2. Inference: constant hard practice without timing either dissipates or overburns. 3. Inference: hexagram lines mark thresholds of yin–yang proportion in the body-time continuum. 4. Inference: “knocking” is testing the line—know the moment, then act with exact dose. 5. Conclusion: direct decoding of the song yields an operational chronometry of elixir work.
entries.logic_practice: 1. Align BaZi hour/day pillars with practice windows: zi–wu axis for major firings; avoid forced work in dead seasonal qi. 2. When luck pillar shifts element, change “fire dose” (intensity of meditation/work), not only life plans. 3. Teach stop-fire: when signs of dryness/irritability appear, hold—overburning is a timing error. 4. Use “knock” as diagnostic question before action: is this moment gathering, refining, or resting? 5. For charts with violent clashes, schedule recovery days as mandatory 止火.
entries.logic_compare: Compared with 玄机直讲’s general demystification, this text specializes in temporal logic of firing. It is more technical than 赤水吟’s poetic expression and less narrative than 西游原旨. Its distinct proof is that chronometry is the core of method, not an accessory.

entries.logic_thesis: The work proves that the ocean of Daoist books conceals one continuous mechanism, and that this mechanism is “easy and simple” once reordered into a single causal curriculum (companions/place → vessel/fire → stillness → foundation → picking the medicine → incubation). Multiplicity of texts is an archival accident; unity of true mechanism is the rational residue after classification. Ease is the sign of truth: what requires endless complications is still confused.
entries.logic_chain: 1. Premise: contradictory surface instructions either address different stages or include errors. 2. Inference: sorting by stage removes most contradictions. 3. Inference: prerequisites (法财侣地, ethics, quiet) are causal, not moral decoration. 4. Inference: without foundation, “picking medicine” is theft from an empty vault. 5. Conclusion: one threaded sequence makes the Path simple, teachable, and self-auditing.
entries.logic_practice: 1. Build a BaZi consultation pipeline matching the volumes: conditions of life → emotional furnace → quiet → foundation → timing → nurture. 2. Refuse advanced “medicine timing” advice for clients still leaking via sex, speech, or overwork. 3. Use “easy-simple” test: if a remedy needs ten talismans, simplify to one causal habit change. 4. Catalog classic quotes under stages so study never floats free of sequence. 5. Measure progress by stage completion, not by collecting methods.
entries.logic_compare: Unlike single-topic polemics (七破论) or single-metaphor poems (无根树), this text’s logic is architectonic: unity through ordered synthesis. It differs from 性命要旨 by emphasizing bibliographic consolidation of many books into one easy thread. Its signature claim is that simplicity is an epistemological criterion of the true mechanism.

entries.logic_thesis: The chants prove—through condensed poetic inference—that nature and life must be cultivated together, and that the “red water” image marks the living, dangerous, fertile boundary where post-heaven blood/qi can be reversed into spiritual fluid. Beauty of verse is not ornament: it compresses causal relations so they can be memorized as operative seals. What cannot be sung into the marrow has not yet been understood.
entries.logic_chain: 1. Premise: dual cultivation is required because xing without ming is empty; ming without xing is blind longevity. 2. Inference: poetic images fix the coupling points (water–fire, metal–wood) in affective memory. 3. Inference: “red water” signals the living intermediate—neither pure form nor pure void. 4. Inference: chanting regulates breath and intent simultaneously, embodying the thesis. 5. Conclusion: poetry is a valid proof vehicle when it encodes necessary relations of reverse alchemy.
entries.logic_practice: 1. For Dry or Water-deficient charts, use short chant+breath sets rather than only conceptual study. 2. Pair each poem image with a BaZi pair (e.g., water–fire) and a daily micro-practice. 3. When emotion runs “red” (passion/anger), treat it as unrefined intermediate—cool with stillness, don’t suppress into dead water. 4. Memorize 2–3 verses as portable correctives during luck shocks. 5. Integrate aesthetic joy as a sign of xing engagement so practice does not become grim force.
entries.logic_compare: Unlike 金丹大旨图’s diagrams, 赤水吟 proves through lyrical compression and embodied recitation. It is less polemical than 七破论 and less narrative than 西游原旨. Its distinctness is aesthetic-operative: beauty as mnemonic of necessity in dual cultivation.

entries.logic_thesis: Wang Dongting’s text proves that all advanced talk collapses into two coupled essentials—xing (nature/spirit) and ming (life/qi-form)—and that Western-school method is judged by whether it reintegrates them without bias. If either pole is absolutized, the system fails: quietism or energetic athleticism both abort the elixir. The “essentials” are therefore a minimal sufficient ontology for practice.
entries.logic_chain: 1. Premise: human being is bipartite in function—awareness and vitality—yet one in origin. 2. Inference: post-heaven education splits them (mind vs body, ethics vs longevity). 3. Inference: reintegration requires ordered work on both, often ming first when foundation is weak, without abandoning xing. 4. Inference: Taiji and yin–yang language is only the physics of that reintegration. 5. Conclusion: mastery is measured by unity of spirit and qi in ordinary action, not by special states alone.
entries.logic_practice: 1. Diagnose every chart as xing-biased (strong Seal/Eating, weak body) or ming-biased (strong body/Wealth, restless spirit) and assign rebalancing. 2. Sequence: stop ming leaks → stabilize breath/sleep → open xing clarity → couple. 3. In Western-school flavor, emphasize practical breath-qi work while holding non-attachment. 4. Reject pure meditation plans for exhausted ming charts; reject pure qigong for scattered xing charts. 5. Define “aim” as functional unity under stress (conflict months), not peak experiences.
entries.logic_compare: Compared with 道书一贯真机易简录’s multi-volume synthesis, 性命要旨 is a minimalist essentialism: two poles, one aim. It is more systematically bipartite than 无根树’s single root metaphor. Its distinct logic is sufficiency—few principles, exhaustive implications for method choice.

entries.name_han: 孙不二女功内丹次第诗注
entries.logic_thesis: The annotated sequence proves that female internal alchemy is not a diluted copy of male method but a distinct causal order grounded in female physiology and lunar timing, while sharing the same ultimate reversion to void. If bodily starting conditions differ, intermediate steps must differ; otherwise the method contradicts its own premise of working with real qi. Gendered sequence is thus a requirement of consistency, not a social concession.
entries.logic_chain: 1. Premise: practice must begin from the actual body-mind one has. 2. Inference: female jing-blood dynamics and cyclical timing change the meaning of “foundation” and “cutting the red dragon.” 3. Inference: poetic stages provide ordered checkpoints specific to that process. 4. Inference: annotations convert poetry into verifiable signs of stage completion. 5. Conclusion: true universality of Dao includes particularized methods; one-size male templates are illogical for female practice.
entries.logic_practice: 1. For female nativities, weight lunar/period-related cycles and blood-qi depletion before applying male-centric firing schedules. 2. Prioritize replenishment and cooling of deficient Fire/Blood patterns before aggressive yang practices. 3. Use stage poems as consentful curriculum: do not skip “beheading the red dragon” metaphors into forced suppression. 4. In BaZi, read Resource/Seal and Officer carefully as support for safe foundation, not only as status stars. 5. Validate each stage by embodied signs (stability, less depletion) rather than copying male lore.
entries.logic_compare: Unlike generic neidan manuals that universalize male sequences, this text’s logic insists on physiological differentiation. It differs from 五篇灵文’s unisex five-phase elixir outline by specializing the path. Its unique proof is that orthodoxy requires adaptive sequence, not identical drills.

entries.logic_thesis: Jiao Hong’s “wings” prove that the Daodejing’s meaning is polyphonic yet bounded: by assembling major commentaries as auxiliary “wings,” it shows that no single scholastic line exhausts Laozi, while mutual correction among wings prevents arbitrary reading. The logical form is critical anthology—truth emerges from structured plurality under the primary text. Authority is distributed across conversation, not monopolized by one sectarian decoder.
entries.logic_chain: 1. Premise: a terse classic generates legitimate interpretive diversity. 2. Inference: isolating one commentary creates blind spots and forced systemizations. 3. Inference: juxtaposing wings exposes where readings converge (strong claims) and diverge (hypothesis). 4. Inference: convergence around emptiness, softness, and reverse-to-root marks the stable core. 5. Conclusion: scholarly multi-perspective method is itself Dao-consistent: not forcing one rigid name.
entries.logic_practice: 1. When interpreting a BaZi classic rule, open at least two “wings” (schools) before deciding. 2. Mark consensus techniques (reduce leakage, follow season) as high confidence; mark sect-only claims as experimental. 3. Use anthology logic in teaching: present alternatives and the test that would decide. 4. Avoid guru-monopoly: allow texts to correct teachers. 5. For ambiguous chart patterns, hold dual hypotheses until life evidence converges.
entries.logic_compare: Unlike 道德宝章 or 老子道德经玄览, which push a unified neidan reading, 老子翼’s logic is meta-hermeneutic and pluralist. It differs from 道德经注’s single-voice system by design. Its distinction is that the method of gathering wings is the argument against interpretive tyranny.

entries.logic_thesis: A classical line-by-line commentary proves that Laozi’s paradoxes form a coherent ontology of the nameless source and a political-ethical physics of non-forcing. By making each chapter entail the next without alchemy-specific jargon, it shows that order arises when rulers and persons stop imposing artificial names and desires on the root. The proof is systematic consistency: non-action is the most efficient causality.
entries.logic_chain: 1. Premise: the Dao as non-being/being source precedes all useful forms. 2. Inference: desire-based naming multiplies disorder in state and person. 3. Inference: returning to simplicity restores spontaneous order (自然). 4. Inference: soft, low, empty positions have strategic causal power. 5. Conclusion: annotation demonstrates a complete practical philosophy of alignment with source—usable even before esoteric neidan overlays.
entries.logic_practice: 1. In BaZi counseling, prefer “reduce forcing” remedies over complex symbolic fixes when Officer/Kill is heavy. 2. Translate “nameless simplicity” into lifestyle: fewer roles, clearer sleep/food baselines. 3. Use soft positions in the chart (hidden stems, dormant qi) as strategic reserves, not weaknesses alone. 4. Apply non-action in timing: sometimes the correct move in a clash year is non-escalation. 5. Read commentary as training in causal minimalism—one root change beats ten branches.
entries.logic_compare: Compared with 道德宝章’s alchemical decoding, 道德经注 (in the mainstream classical sense) argues a more general ontological-ethical physics. It is less anthological than 老子翼 and less explicitly elixir-staged than 道德经解 in Daoist-sect usages. Its distinct logic is philosophical coherence without requiring neidan premises.

entries.logic_thesis: Bai Yuchan’s “precious chapters” prove that the Daodejing is a sealed neidan scripture: chapters map onto spirit–qi work so tightly that Laozi becomes an upper vehicle of golden elixir rather than mere quietist politics. The argument is translational consistency—once key terms (One, spirit of the valley, mysterious female) are fixed as internal functions, the book reads as a continuous operations manual. Preciousness lies in this reversible mapping between classic and practice.
entries.logic_chain: 1. Premise: Southern-lineage neidan holds that ancient classics encrypt elixir. 2. Inference: stable internal referents can be assigned to Laozi’s images. 3. Inference: political metaphors then re-describe governance of the inner kingdom. 4. Inference: non-action equals non-forcing of post-heaven intention upon pre-heaven medicine. 5. Conclusion: Daodejing, properly decoded, is a complete precious manual of return.
entries.logic_practice: 1. Re-read “valley spirit” as open, receptive mid-space practice; use for charts with rigid Metal/Officer over-control. 2. Treat “mysterious female” as inexhaustible resource function—cultivate Seal/Resource lifestyle in depleted nativities. 3. Govern the “state” of the body: reduce tax (overwork), stop war (anger), fill granaries (sleep/jing). 4. Apply chapter-order as deepening: from ontology to embodiment to social non-contention. 5. Test decoding: if a reading cannot become a bodily task, revise the reading.
entries.logic_compare: Unlike 道德经注’s philosophical generalism, 道德宝章 commits to full neidan encryption. Relative to 老子道德经玄览’s mirror-contemplation emphasis, Bai’s text is more operational-elixir in Southern Song style. Its uniqueness is confident one-to-one mapping of Laozi onto golden elixir craft.

entries.logic_thesis: The “explanation” genre proves that Laozi becomes usable only when compressed paradox is expanded into explicit causal sentences and examples—understanding is the middle term between text and practice. If students cannot restate the classic in clear propositions, they cannot apply it; therefore 解 is not dilution but necessary logical unpacking. Clarity here serves conversion of wisdom into conduct.
entries.logic_chain: 1. Premise: ultra-brief classics underdetermine action. 2. Inference: authentic explanation adds structure without adding alien dogma. 3. Inference: each chapter yields premises about mind, society, and reverse effort. 4. Inference: practical maxims must remain falsifiable in daily governance of desire. 5. Conclusion: 解 completes the communicative arc from mystery to method while remaining subordinate to the root text.
entries.logic_practice: 1. After any Daodejing quote in a BaZi session, force a one-sentence operational gloss. 2. Build a personal glossary: Dao, de, soft, reverse—each with a chart-related behavior. 3. Use explanations to design week-long experiments (e.g., “lower position” in conflict). 4. Avoid explanation bloat: cut any gloss that cannot change a choice. 5. Teach clients to re-explain in their own words as a mastery check.
entries.logic_compare: Compared with 老子翼’s multi-commentator wings, 道德经解 typically offers a single continuous expository voice. It is more pedagogical-unpacking than 道德宝章’s esoteric remapping. Its distinct logic is communicative: expansion as the condition of practice.

entries.logic_thesis: Annotation of the “Song of the Blue Sky” proves that pure yang mind—clear as an open sky—is both the method and the verification of alchemy: clouds are adventitious thoughts/desires, not the sky’s nature. If clarity can be sung, recognized, and stabilized, then enlightenment is not remote metaphysics but the sky-like quality of awareness restored. Commentary ties poetic rapture to disciplined clearing.
entries.logic_chain: 1. Premise: original mind is naturally clear (qing tian). 2. Inference: afflictions are weather, not essence. 3. Inference: practice is dispersing clouds without attacking the sky. 4. Inference: stable blue-sky mind naturally orders qi (ming follows xing clarity). 5. Conclusion: the song plus notes provide a criterion of attainment—sky-likeness under conditions—not accumulation of inner scenery.
entries.logic_practice: 1. For cluttered charts (many clash/punishment/desire stars), train “sky watching”: note thoughts as clouds; return. 2. Use sky criterion in review: did today’s practice leave more open awareness or more images/drama? 3. Pair with breath to clear “steam” when Fire steam-clouds the mind. 4. In prediction years of turmoil, prescribe sky practice as first response before strategic action. 5. Avoid chasing visionary “auspicious clouds” as goals; they are still weather.
entries.logic_compare: Unlike 敲爻歌直解’s fire-timing grids, 青天歌注释 centers xing-clarity as the master proof. It is lighter and more mind-only in emphasis than 性命要旨’s strict dual essentials, though annotations often reconnect to qi. Its uniqueness is the sky metaphor as a live phenomenological standard of the Path.

entries.logic_thesis: The Five Spiritual Texts prove that elixir work is a closed causal sequence of five necessities—jade liquid, producing the medicine, gathering, obtaining, and warming/nurturing—each preconditioning the next. Skipping stages is not ambitious; it is logically invalid, like harvesting without planting. Attributed Northern-lineage notes bind the sequence to heavenly heart as master and original spirit as function, proving method as ordered transformation of the three treasures.
entries.logic_chain: 1. Premise: internal medicines appear only after preparatory fluids/qi are restored (玉液). 2. Inference: production (产药) without gathering skill wastes the peak. 3. Inference: gathering without the ability to “obtain” (stabilize) is temporary excitement. 4. Inference: obtaining without warming leads to regression. 5. Conclusion: five chapters are five non-negotiable links; the Path is the integrity of the chain under guidance of heavenly heart.
entries.logic_practice: 1. Audit practice/BaZi plans against the five links; locate the broken link (usually foundation or stop-fire nurture). 2. For weak Resource charts, emphasize jade-liquid restoration (sleep, fluids, gentle breath) before “gathering” intense methods. 3. Time “gathering” to real openings (seasonal/day-night), not willfulness. 4. After any breakthrough (insight, energy peak), schedule温养 days. 5. Hold 天心 as master: if ego-excitement leads, abort the stage as false medicine.
entries.logic_compare: Unlike 孙不二…次第’s gender-specific poetry, 五篇灵文 offers a compact unisex five-phase causal skeleton of Northern neidan. It is more strictly sequential than 玄机直讲’s general plain teaching. Its distinct proof is chain-necessity: five named links as the minimal complete engine of elixir.

entries.logic_thesis: The scripture proves that the immortal path is identical with “returning to the origin” (还元): all techniques are true only insofar as they reverse dispersion back to the pre-heaven source. Immortality is not endless forward survival of the post-heaven person but completion of reversion; thus “true” marks correspondence with origin, not miraculous deviation from law. The end-state is the beginning recovered consciously.
entries.logic_chain: 1. Premise: living beings fall from origin into multiplicity and leakage. 2. Inference: forward cultivation that only enhances post-heaven skills deepens exile. 3. Inference: true immortal method must be reverse-oriented at every step. 4. Inference: signs of authenticity are increasing simplicity, unity, and independence from conditions. 5. Conclusion: 还元 is the definition, criterion, and method of 仙道—one term, complete law.
entries.logic_practice: 1. Evaluate every BaZi remedy by the return test: does it reduce dispersion and restore origin-like simplicity? 2. Prefer reverse interventions (rest, silence, containment) when charts show hyper-output. 3. Track annual luck as approach/departure from personal origin pattern (day-master balance), not only as wealth events. 4. End sessions with one 还元 act (breath to root, gratitude without grasping). 5. Discard techniques that produce more complexity, dependency, or identity inflation.
entries.logic_compare: Compared with 无根树’s graft metaphor, 仙道还元真经 states the same reversion in scriptural definitional form—origin as the truth-condition of all methods. It is more slogan-complete and criterion-focused than 悟道录’s long experiential dialectic. Its unique logical role is final-criterion: whatever does not return to origin is not the immortal path, regardless of brand.
